name: DR Congo (east)
value: Masisi villages contested; no city falls
summary: Army and FRN/M23 rebels keep fighting over Masisi villages after 3 Nov; no major city has changed hands
state: Congolese forces retook Mahanga and Kilongo in Masisi from 3 Nov, and FRN/M23 fighters tried to recapture Mahanga on 6 Nov (Radio Okapi; Actualite.cd). Fighting intensified on the Kashebere–Kibati axis on 5–6 Nov, with at least four civilians killed in Masisi clashes (Radio Okapi). The US sanctioned Rwanda's defence ministry on 28 Oct for supporting the rebels (Critical Threats). Searches on 10 Nov found no capture of a major city or direct interstate fighting.
for_you: Fighting in North and South Kivu keeps displacing civilians. FCDO advises against all travel to the eastern provinces.
rubric_hit: Active fighting: Masisi and Kashebere–Kibati clashes 3–6 Nov; no major city captured
